title: Design Python bindings via PyO3 + maturin
description: Design a `swisseph-python` workspace member that wraps the `swisseph` lib crate directly via PyO3 (not through swisseph-ffi). Maturin for wheel builds and distribution. Key design questions: API surface (mirror C swetest names vs Pythonic rename), GIL release strategy (Ephemeris is Send+Sync so release during calc), wheel CI matrix, whether to publish to PyPI.

decisions.decision: Use PyO3 + maturin, not ctypes/cffi wrapping swisseph-ffi
decisions.rationale: swisseph-ffi's flattened C ABI (out-params, error buffers, nullable pointers) was designed for Dart's dart:ffi. Wrapping it in Python means un-flattening everything. Going straight from swisseph lib → PyO3 skips the round-trip, gives native Python exceptions, keyword args, type stubs. Distribution via pip install is the killer feature over ctypes/cffi.
decisions.rejected_alternative: ctypes/cffi wrapping the existing cdylib — avoids new Rust code but produces awkward Python ergonomics and has no pip-installable wheel story

execution_record: Design completed via brainstorm + domain session 2026-07-07. Deliverables live in the new standalone repo ~/nhs/soft/astrology/pyswisseph-rs: CONTEXT.md (mapping rules, closed deviation list, naming/GIL/construction rules), ADR 0001 (PyO3 direct on lib crate, not swisseph-ffi), ADR 0002 (strict 1:1 transliteration). PRD published as pyswisseph-rs/1 in the new yojana project. Divergence from task description: standalone repo consuming swisseph-rs 0.1.0 from crates.io, NOT a workspace member. Key decisions beyond the pre-recorded one: Pythonic-only API (no pyswisseph compat shim), full api-surface.md coverage, import name swisseph_rs, abi3-py311 wheels via maturin-action + PyPI trusted publishing, verbatim Rust variant names for exception classes in swisseph_rs.errors.
